title: Aurora Opportunity Window
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture
| bin _time span=1h
| stats max(aurora_kp_estimate) as aurora_kp_estimate, avg(cloud_cover_pct) as cloud_cover_pct by camera _time
| where aurora_kp_estimate>=6 AND cloud_cover_pct<40
| sort - aurora_kp_estimate
description: Uses Allsky camera night-sky summaries telemetry to monitor hours where geomagnetic conditions and cloud cover lined up for aurora viewing in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for rare clear windows worth checking live, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Allsky camera night-sky summaries data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
visualization: Hourly chart of aurora estimate and cloud cover.
detailedImplementation:
## Prerequisites

• **Splunk**: Splunk Enterprise ≥9.0 or Splunk Cloud — a single-instance home lab is fine. Create `index=personal` with 90–365 day retention (`indexes.conf`).
• **HEC token**: Settings → Data Inputs → HTTP Event Collector → New Token → index `personal`. Store the token in your connector's environment (never commit it to git).
• **Upstream product**: Personal HEC index — HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.
• **Subcategory context**: Citizen Science & Backyard Sensing — typical feeds: Seismograph (`seismo:reading`), Geiger counter (`geiger:cpm`), lightning strikes (`lightning:strike`), radon (`radon:reading`), all-sky meteor camera (`allsky:capture`), river-level gauge (`riverlevel.
• **Sourcetypes in this search**: `allsky:capture`.
• **Network**: The connector host must reach both the vendor API/MQTT broker and your Splunk HEC port (8088/tcp).

## Step 1 — Configure data collection

Route **Personal HEC index** events into `index=personal` with `sourcetype=allsky:capture`.

**Collection method:** HTTP Event Collector token on index=personal.

**Reference endpoint / path:** `POST https://<splunk>:8088/services/collector/event`.

**Suggested poll interval:** depends on upstream connector.

**Key fields to extract:** `sourcetype-specific — see search filters`.

**Typical connector stack:** DIY citizen-science sensors — Raspberry Shake seismograph, Geiger counter, AS3935/Blitzortung lightning detector, radon monitor, all-sky meteor camera, river-level gauge, and magnetometer — via MQTT and scripted inputs to Splunk HEC..

**Author notes:** Ingest Allsky camera night-sky summaries data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.


Example HEC payload shape:

```json
{"index": "personal", "sourcetype": "allsky:capture", "event": { ... vendor fields ... }}
```

Verify ingestion with:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture earliest=-24h | head 20
```

## Step 2 — Create the search and alert

This search implements **Aurora Opportunity Window** over `personal` data (primarily `sourcetype=allsky:capture`) across the full search range. It applies numeric thresholds on `aurora_kp_estimate` (>= 6) after max, avg — tune these constants to your household baseline.

**Fields this search depends on:** `_time`, `aurora_kp_estimate`, `camera`, `cloud_cover_pct`. Confirm each is populated before scheduling alerts.

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture
| bin _time span=1h
| stats max(aurora_kp_estimate) as aurora_kp_estimate, avg(cloud_cover_pct) as cloud_cover_pct by camera _time
| where aurora_kp_estimate>=6 AND cloud_cover_pct<40
| sort - aurora_kp_estimate
```

## Step 3 — Validate

**(a) Compare to vendor UI:** Splunk Search → index=personal | stats count by sourcetype. Totals for the same day/week should match within connector lag (usually one poll interval).

**(b) Field presence:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture earliest=-7d
| head 50
| table _time, aurora_kp_estimate, camera, cloud_cover_pct
```

Every column the detection uses should be non-null on recent rows.

**(c) Volume sanity:**

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture earliest=-30d
| timechart span=1d count
```

Flatlines usually mean a broken token, expired OAuth refresh, or HEC URL change.

**(d) Threshold calibration:** Profile `aurora_kp_estimate` before alerting:

```spl
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture earliest=-30d
| stats perc50(aurora_kp_estimate) AS p50 perc90(aurora_kp_estimate) AS p90 perc99(aurora_kp_estimate) AS p99 max(aurora_kp_estimate) AS hi
```

## Step 4 — Operationalize

Create a companion dashboard titled `UC-25.20.32: Personal evidence` with the following panel layout:

**Panel 1 — Hourly Chart Of Aurora Estimate And Cloud Cover (the key fields):** Configure according to standard Splunk visualization patterns for this panel type.


Time picker defaults: set to last 30 days with named presets for 24h, 7d, 30d, 90d, and 1y — the auditor needs all five windows without retyping. Enable scheduled PDF export for the full dashboard on the regulation's reporting cadence.

## Step 5 — Troubleshooting

**Personal HEC index — no Personal HEC index events / missing fields:** If `allsky:capture` stops updating, re-check HEC token, index `personal`, and firewall to port 8088. Search `index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd group=http_event_collector` for rejection reasons. Confirm the Personal HEC index connector script is still running (`systemctl status` or cron log).

**Personal HEC index — NULL values in extracted fields:** The Personal HEC index JSON export shape drifted — compare a raw event (`index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture | head 1 | spath`) against the field names in Step 2. Re-map in the connector before changing the SPL.

**Personal HEC index — API error / auth denied (401/403):** Refresh tokens expire on most consumer APIs — re-authorize the scripted input, update `passwords.conf` / env vars, and verify the vendor developer app is not in sandbox mode.

**Personal HEC index — endpoint timeout / HTTP 429 throttling:** Back off the poll interval in the connector; Personal HEC index APIs often cap requests per 15 minutes on free tiers.

**Bucket misalignment:** `span=1h` buckets on UTC by default — if your routine is local-time based, add `| eval _time=_time + (local_offset)` or use `@d` / `@w` snap.

**Stale dashboard:** Confirm the saved search `dispatch.earliest_time` covers enough history for your `1h` buckets.
